Ratin Pedals browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Ratin Pedals Blue Angel Published on June 1, 2011 Ratin Pedals overdrive pedal Information Ratin Pedals This pedal is an all analog, natural sounding, soft to medium gain overdrive pedal that can produce wide varieties of tones suitable for blues and rock styles. This pedal has got an open sound like amps, rolling back the volume knob softens the sound and puts out a half clean sound. It's got 2 switches that help you get your desired tone easier. One of them deals with the dynamic range and the other with the tonality before the distorting stage. The dynamic switch enables you to choose between 3 distinct dynamic range, it starts from being too wide and open, which is the mid position, then limits the range in lower position and the then the upper is the most compressed, fat and sustained mode. The Fat switch, fattens up the sound, you can use it when the pick up sound is thin. This pedal works with 9 volt regulated DC adapter. Features: This pedal produces real blues and rock tones.
